# Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec (MNBAQ)

> > National fine arts museum of Quebec featuring Quebec art, major artists like Jean Paul Riopelle and Jean-Paul Lemieux, and the Automatistes movement.

The MNBAQ is Quebec's premier fine arts institution, supported by the Fondation du Musée, which leads major philanthropic initiatives including the Espace Riopelle — Pavillon Michael Audain project. The museum champions Quebec art through acquisitions, contemporary art prizes, and educational programs at the Centre d'éducation par les arts.
